en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Ahmad b. `Ali b. Asad al-Asadi narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Abi Bakr al-Wasiti narrated to us. He said: `Abdullah b. Yusuf al-Jarudi narrated to us. He said: Abu Ishaq al-Fazari narrated to us from Sufyan al-Thawri and al-A`mash from `Abdullah b. al-Sa’ib from Zadhan from `Abdullah b. Mas`ud. He said:
The Messenger of Allah (s) said: For Allah, there are angels who visit the Earth who deliver the salaam of my Nation to me.
